metadata.purpose: Pre-child-finetuning candidate output baseline; not a ranking of post-finetuning suitability, product acceptance, or clinically annotated phone accuracy
metadata.selection_objective: Select a jamo/phone backbone, fine-tune on owned child speech, then assess deployment suitability

adaptation_status.child: Already fine-tuned on owned child training data
adaptation_status.native_phone: Public checkpoint; no owned child fine-tuning performed
adaptation_status.foreign_phone: Public checkpoint; no owned child fine-tuning performed

metadata.selection: AIHub speaker test split; sha256 sort; first 20 per available music keyword; union deduplicated
normalization: Intended/supplied transcript -> unchanged project g2pkk -> IPA; child ASR text through same pipeline
Native MFA phones -> table adapter; foreign mixed NFD/compat jamo -> position-aware phone adapter, no second G2P
ae/e -> e for every model and reference, matching the native 40-phone inventory; not a claim all speakers merge them
coda l followed by onset tap -> l l for every model and reference
ng retained in foreign compatibility-jamo labels even before a vowel; silent explicit NFD initial ieung omitted
Only CTC blank and boundaries/special BOS/EOS ignored; unknown labels remain errors
limitations: Reference labels are transcripts/intended words, not expert phone annotations
External child 83 clips include one whole phrase and manually unreviewed boundaries; supplied transcription retained
Age of music two-speaker recordings not independently verified
Test speaker/file exclusion verified against current child train and dev manifests; public model pretraining overlap unknown
Same 2.5-second windows/0.5-second hop/zero onset offset, frozen preprocessing and no thresholds tuned
No actual wa-only negative audio tested; two jak-a negatives are too few for a stable false-acceptance estimate
GPU Python inference only; no ONNX, Unity, or deployment validation
